inputs: Decision scope, permission, available options, revision and original request receipt.

scenes.label: Waiting for a decision
scenes.headline: Return the brief for revision?
scenes.body: The proposed scope includes two deliverables. Returning it asks the work owner to revise the brief before work resumes.

scenes.label: Scope changed
scenes.headline: The brief changed during review.
scenes.body: The work owner added a deliverable after revision 7. Read revision 8 before recording a decision.

scenes.label: Request recorded
scenes.headline: Your decision was sent.
scenes.body: Meatball has recorded the request and is waiting for the outcome.

scenes.label: Acknowledgement lost
scenes.headline: The outcome is still unknown.
scenes.body: The connection closed before the result arrived. The original request can be looked up.

scenes.label: Change confirmed
scenes.headline: The brief was returned for revision.
scenes.body: The work owner can now revise the brief.

inputs: Authorized record, as-of time, source revision, coverage and current access.

scenes.label: Current record
scenes.headline: Company work
scenes.body: The reporting desk owns the weekly review. The service confirmed this revision at 09:40 UTC.

scenes.label: Partial coverage
scenes.headline: Some work details are unavailable.
scenes.body: The service confirmed the owner. The next duty is outside this response’s coverage.

scenes.label: Last confirmed record
scenes.headline: Last confirmed at 09:40 UTC
scenes.body: The displayed facts still belong to revision 42. The service has not confirmed a newer revision.

scenes.label: Access withdrawn
scenes.headline: This record is unavailable.
scenes.body: Access to the record could not be confirmed.

scenes.label: Empty result
scenes.headline: No work has been recorded yet.
scenes.body: The service returned an empty work history for the current scope.

scenes.label: Initial read failed
scenes.headline: The work record could not be loaded.
scenes.body: The first read failed before any authorized record arrived.
